title: Freelance Transcriptionist - Afrikaans
description:
About Perle

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. We specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Perle is hiring a freelance transcriptionist fluent in Afrikaans for a remote transcription role. This is a paid contract position open to qualified contributors worldwide.

1. Role Overview

You will transcribe 2-speaker, channel-separated audio recordings in Afrikaans. Each file has two clearly separated speakers. Your job is to produce a clean, accurate, sequentially ordered transcript with speaker labels and timestamps.

2. What You Will Do

• Listen to 2-speaker audio recordings in Afrikaans

• Type out what each speaker says, accurately and in full

• Label each speaker turn as Speaker 1 or Speaker 2, matching the audio channel

• Add timestamps at the start of each speaker turn (format: HH:MM:SS)

• Ensure transcripts are sequential with no unexplained gaps

3. Requirements

• Native or near-native fluency in Afrikaans (spoken and written)

• Strong written Afrikaans - accurate spelling, punctuation, and grammar

• Ability to work independently and meet daily output targets

• Access to a computer with a stable internet connection

• Availability for at least 4 hours per day

• Prior transcription experience is a plus but not required - all contributors must pass a qualification test

4. Quality Standard

• Word Error Rate (WER) of 5% or less on all delivered transcripts

• Zero speaker label errors - Speaker 1 must always correspond to Channel 1

• Transcripts reviewed on a rolling basis; feedback provided promptly

• Files that do not meet the quality threshold will be returned for correction

5. Project Details

Detail

Information

Language required

Afrikaans

Project type

Audio transcription (manual)

Commitment

~at least 4 hours/day (remote, flexible schedule)

Start date

As soon as qualified - rolling onboarding

6. How to Apply

Submit your application through the Perle platform. Applicants who pass the resume check will be onboarded immediately and assigned to production tasks.

Perle is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

title: Senior Portfolio Analyst - Infrastructure Finance
description:
Farmer Mac is looking to hire a driven, analytical, industry-focused and personable individual for a Senior Portfolio Analyst - Infrastructure position on its renewable energy infrastructure portfolio management team. The position will support Farmer Mac’s Infrastructure Finance team.

Position Summary

The role will be responsible for supporting Farmer Mac’s existing portfolio of complex renewable energy project finance loans to finance independent power projects, including loans to projects that are under construction or those that are operational, and construction bridge loans that monetize tax credits. Credit Analyst will interact and coordinate closely with other members of the Infrastructure Finance team, which includes Credit Underwriting teams, Relationship Managers, and Portfolio Strategy & Analytics within our Renewable Energy, Broadband Infrastructure, and Power & Utilities business segments. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, preparing and managing loan modification/consents/amendment requests, performing ongoing risk rating assessments and required reviews, loan refinancing transactions, legal document review, coordinating with loan operations on reviewing and processing borrowing and disbursement requests, interfacing with internal stakeholders, including Underwriting, Credit, Capital Markets, and Loan Operations. Additionally, this role will support underwriting of new loans, preparation of credit memos, performing and managing due diligence activities, industry and market analysis, preparing and/or reviewing complex cash flow project finance models, closing activities, and assist in the execution of loan purchases.

This role is expected to immediately contribute towards accelerating growth within Farmer Mac’s Infrastructure Finance business and significantly contribute to Farmer Mac’s strategic objectives and initiatives. Suitable candidate must be a proactive self-starter, be able to work on and assist in completing various deals at multiple stages of development, work with minimal supervision and be an active and efficient communicator.

Team Summary

Farmer Mac’s Infrastructure Finance team is a fast-paced, knowledgeable, mission-oriented team lending to organizations that finance renewable energy project finance transactions, power and utility entities and broadband companies, in addition to providing wholesale lending to a select group of financial institutions. Infrastructure Finance has delivered significant growth and is a crucial business in the execution of Farmer Mac’s strategic plan. The segment’s focus is on deepening existing client relationships, developing new customer relationships, and diversifying the products offered to clients.

The People You Will Work With

The Senior Portfolio Analyst will be an integral part of the Infrastructure Finance team, reporting directly to the Portfolio Manager - Renewable Energy and will have regular ongoing interactions with the Underwriters, Managing Directors within Infrastructure Finance, Capital Markets, Transaction Management, and internal and external advisors and legal counsel.

Where and When You Will Work

The position can be based in Farmer Mac’s Washington, DC or Johnston, IA, locations or remote. Farmer Mac embraces a Presence with Purpose work environment, which allows for flexibility of work location while providing the opportunity for teams to come together in the office with purpose. Work outside of core hours may be required for planned and unplanned activities to complete time sensitive projects or to attend off-site meetings or events.

Primary Responsibilities and Duties

• Support Infrastructure Finance loan performances and collaborate with key internal stakeholders, including Credit, Underwriters, and Relationship Managers.

title: NPI TPM, Product Engineering
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Extreme ownership. Full autonomy. Own things end to end often taking on scope outside your core role without being asked to get things done.

- Velocity. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- First principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 

THE PRODUCT ENGINEERING TEAM

Product Engineering takes the hardware behind gigawatt-scale AI data centers from concept to rate production: racks, gear, and power conversion built as products, not one-off projects.

Examples of key problems the team is working on:

- Drive new product families (rack, gear, power conversion) through stage gates from kickoff to rate production on schedules set by data center delivery dates, not by when the design feels done.

- Manage long-lead components and DVT-stage design changes against 20-week-plus lead times without blowing the program.

- Keep design, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain converging on the same build, the same revision, and the same date across multiple concurrent programs.

- Build gate reviews and readiness scoring rigorous enough that a pass means the product is actually ready, not that the meeting ran out of objections.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own the program schedule, stage gates, and cross-functional execution for a product family (rack, gear, or power conversion) from kickoff through rate production.

- Run risk and dependency management across design, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain, with tooling and judgment that surface the top risks early instead of a status-report factory that surfaces nothing.

- Facilitate gate reviews and readiness scoring, and hold the line on what kills a pass, even when the schedule pressure says wave it through.

- Broker escalations and decisions between engineering and delivery so long-lead calls get made in days instead of weeks.

- Build program schedules that hold up even when the design team says everything is uncertain, with explicit assumptions and decision dates instead of padding.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

- 5-10 years of technical program management of hardware NPI at an OEM, ODM, or hyperscaler, running programs from kickoff through stage gates to rate production.

- An engineering degree and enough technical depth to hold design reviews honest: you can tell the difference between a real answer and a slide.

- You've made the hard call on a slipping program (cut scope, slip the date, or spend to recover) and can walk through the decision and what it cost.

- You've handled a DVT-stage component change against a 20-week lead time and know how to run that decision: who's in the room, what data

title: Senior Manager, AI Agents and Automation
description:
Why Jerry .ai ?

• Join a pre-IPO startup with capital ($240M raised), traction (5M+ customers), and runway (we’re profitable).

• Impact: Come lead our customer-facing Agentic AI product leveraging LLMs, agents, and internal APIs to create a magical experience for our customers. Work with partners like OpenAI to integrate Jerry .ai services directly into the ChatGPT App and pioneer new model capabilities.

• Accelerated career growth. We have a flat org chart, ambitious goals, and no shortage of opportunities for people who want more. You’ll also report directly to our COO, leading one of our most important growth levers.

Why we’re hiring this role:
Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning one is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey - buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs - is fragmented, complicated, and expensive. Jerry .ai is building the first app to manage it all.
We launched car insurance in 2019 and became one of the top three brokers in the country. We got there in part because we were early on generative AI. Before off-the-shelf platforms existed, we built our own infrastructure to automate sales and service conversations. Today, that system handles a meaningful share of customer interactions end-to-end. The underlying technology is entirely homegrown.
That head start created real leverage. It also created real complexity. Prompts that power everything from the customer-facing chatbot to vehicle photo validation to back-office automation now live across six separate locations. There is no single source of truth, no unified platform, and no clear owner of where the next big bets - voicebot, computer use, consumer AI applications - belong on the roadmap. That is what you will own.
How you’ll make an impact:
You will sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and applied AI as you build and scale a sophisticated system that already automates >70% of inbound sales and service requests (over 50k chats per month). Your role will include shaping how modern LLM systems, human-in-the-loop feedback, and computer-use agents redefine an entire industry. Specifically:

• Lead end-to-end development for our AI platform and customer experiences, from initial roadmap to rollout.

• Partner with engineers to design prompt strategies, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails-balancing latency, cost, and accuracy.

• Serve as the technical translator between engineering and the broader organization, establishing AI best practices and platform standards.

• Drive systematic improvement in answer quality, customer satisfaction, and automation rates through rigorous experimentation.

• Work with partners at OpenAI to evaluate and deploy the next generation of voice models and workflow automation.

Who you are:

• Technologist: You live and breathe AI. You read the release notes when a new model drops and you’ve already built your own custom workflows.

• Systems Thinker: You are comfortable diving into technical conversations about API design and system architecture, translating complex concepts for any audience.

• Experimenter: You think only in terms of what’s possible. AI is rapidly evolving, and you’re constantly tinkering and finding new capabilities that didn’t exist yesterday.

• Data-Driven: You are familiar with SQL and comfortable diving into the data to answer your own questions and validate hypotheses.

• Pragmatic: You can navigate technical tradeoffs and lead by example when implementing AI platform standards.

Ideal experience:

• 4+ years of experience in a technical role like forward deployed engineering, technical product management, or similar at a fast-paced startup.

• Passion and curiosity for AI systems including modern LLMs, etc.

• Track record of taking complex, strategic ideas and turning them into scalable, production-grade products.

title: Senior Platform Engineer - Infrastructure (USA)
description:
About Kalepa :

Insurance is a $7T global industry built on professional labor: underwriting, claims, pricing, operations, and distribution. Kalepa is building AI that can perform that work.

We create professional-grade AI systems for insurers: software that can read, reason, decide, and act inside real workflows and operate over long-time horizons. Kalepa begins by augmenting professionals with the tools to succeed at their jobs. That earns us the right to learn from real decisions, capture decision traces, and automate what can be automated successfully over time.

Our products are already in production with leading insurers, driving measurable outcomes and expanding across functions. The opportunity is far broader than any single workflow: to build the AI operating system for decision-making across insurance. For people who want to work on AI that matters, in a sector where correctness, trust, and real-world impact count, Kalepa is just getting started.

Kalepa is backed by leading investors such as IA Ventures and Inspired Capital, and our team brings experience from Facebook, Palantir, Google, Amazon, McKinsey, Mastercard, and Uber.

Our Values (This is important):

Many organizations have a dusty list of corporate values that no one ever follows. Kalepa is not one of those companies. Our values are designed to unlock the potential of our employees.

Success at Kalepa is bred from five core principles:

•
Hustle and Determination - We hire people who take full ownership of their craft and relentlessly pursue excellence with speed and determination. We choose the hard problems and do not give up. This is the foundation of how we work and how we win.

•
Deliver Customer Impact - We're obsessed with customer impact. Every feature, every line of code, every decision is measured against one question: does this help insurers make better decisions? If it doesn't drive speed, accuracy, or profitability for our customers, we don't build it.

•
Meritocracy - We're building something exceptional, and that requires exceptional people and ideas. We have a high bar but we reward excellence with rapid growth. If you're the best at what you do, you'll thrive here.

•
Transparency - We value honest, transparent communication over politics. We challenge ideas, not people. We say what needs to be said, even when it's hard. This is how we solve problems fast and find the truth.

•
Experiment Relentlessly - Many of the problems we face have never been solved before. We tackle them by testing quickly, measuring rigorously, and iterating until we find the path forward. Speed of learning is our advantage.

In addition to our NY office, we have remote employees speaking 10+ languages across the globe. But we invest in bringing our people together both for regional meetups and global offsites (2021 - Playa Del Carmen | 2022 - Rome | 2023 - Buenos Aires | 2024 - Lisbon | 2025 - Cartagena).

Kalepa ’s culture isn’t for everyone, and that’s ok. But for the people who are a fit, they can’t imagine working elsewhere.

You’ll maintain CI/CD pipelines, automate operational workflows, and ensure we stay secure and compliant to the industry standards. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include improving infrastructure performance and reliability, monitoring and optimizing system cost, and collaborating with engineering teams to standardize environments and deployment patterns. You’ll help to maintain observability and incident response processes, and ensure the scalability of our cloud-based systems as we continue to grow.

title: Practice Lead: AWS
description:
Practice Lead: AWS
The Practice Lead for AWS is a hands-on leader dedicated to helping customers get the most out of open-source databases running on AWS and the broader AWS ecosystem around them (EKS, Aurora, RDS, ElastiCache, MSK, and the like). While the primary focus is on database environments, the Lead provides architectural guidance across the surrounding infrastructure whenever it affects database performance, cost, or reliability.
As a recognized thought leader, the Practice Lead stays at the forefront of how the AWS platform is evolving, offering strategic advice and direct assistance with complex implementations and migrations.
This is a dedicated, AWS-specific role. We may stand up equivalent practices for other hyperscalers (Azure, GCP) down the road, but for now, the scope is intentionally focused on AWS, and we want deep, real expertise in that ecosystem rather than shallow coverage across three clouds at once.
Our Philosophy: Meet the Customer Where They Are
This role is built around a simple idea: we meet customers where they are, and for a large and growing number of them, that's AWS. The Practice Lead should default to AWS solutions wherever they're the natural, appropriate fit for the customer, and be genuinely enthusiastic about it, not begrudgingly supportive of it. At the same time, "natural fit" is doing real work in that sentence. If a fully managed AWS service isn't the right call for a given customer's cost, portability, or technical requirements, the Practice Lead should say so plainly and recommend the better path, even if that path runs through self-managed or Percona -supported open-source instead.
The job isn't to force AWS onto customers who don't need it, and it isn't to steer people away from AWS out of some reflexive preference for open source either. It's to give customers a straight, technically grounded recommendation and let the right answer win. That's our value of putting the customer ahead of Percona , in practice.
Key Responsibilities

• Customer Advocacy: Act in the best interest of the customer. You will champion Percona 's expertise and, where it fits, Percona software and services, but the customer's outcome always comes first, regardless of which tools or platform features get them there.

• Existing Customer Growth: This role isn't just about net-new logos. A meaningful part of the job is looking after Percona 's existing customer base as it relates to AWS, in two directions. First, customers already running in AWS environments today: helping them get more value out of that setup, whether that's performance tuning, cost optimization, or adopting additional AWS or Percona services they aren't using yet. Second, customers who aren't on AWS today but are actively migrating there: making sure that transition goes smoothly, that Percona 's support and services move with them, and that we don't lose ground with a customer just because their infrastructure is changing.

• Product & Partnership Influence: Act as a strategic advisor to internal Percona teams to improve our software and services for customers running on AWS. You will work closely with our internal Cloud Partnership team on our formal relationship with AWS (co-sell motions, partner programs, joint go-to-market), while you own the technical depth and credibility that makes that partnership valuable in the first place.

• Business Growth: This is a results-oriented role. Success is measured by the revenue and profitability of the AWS Practice, its contribution to Percona subscriptions (Support, Managed Services, etc.), partnership revenue, and overall customer satisfaction.

• Thought Leadership: Drive Percona 's presence in the AWS and open source database space through content creation, professional networking, and speaking engagements at industry conferences and AWS-specific events (re:Invent and the like).

• Service Design: Architect professional service offerings and packages, such as migration assessments, cost optim

Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.

We are looking for a highly motivated Head of Revenue Operations & Strategy (f/d/m). You’ll work closely with our revenue team and CRO in a collaborative, fast-moving, VC-funded startup.

THE HIRING PROCESS

Run the B2B sales function. Joining a fast-moving team and helping us scale a world-class sales organization to its next level, you’ll focus on executing and optimizing our sales processes, managing client relationships, and driving measurable results in enterprise sales.

•
Go after high-potential leads. Identify and cold-call on-target businesses to build a portfolio of respected, revenue-driving corporate clients.

Learn the industry inside and out. Understand the incentives, pressure points, and decision-makers of your industry so you can build profitable relationships.

•
Work closely with the product. Speak about it with clarity and confidence. Gather feedback from clients and share input to help shape future development.

•
Follow the data. Keep a close eye on performance metrics to gauge impact and zero in on the highest-value opportunities.

•
Stand out at every touchpoint. Deliver outstanding service that builds trust with every client interaction.

What we look for

•
Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do-and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high-and rising-bar.

•
Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.

•
Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.

•
Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer

•
An exceptional opportunity for growth . We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential-then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. If you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects.

•
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.

•
Competitive pay. Typically, we offer individuals with limited experience a base salary of $70,173 to $91,661 in the US, with an additional performance-based variable compensation component. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Search & Index
description:
THE ROLE

We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer for our Search & Indexing team, responsible for making Wayve’s massive corpus of multimodal video data discoverable and searchable. This team builds the indexing infrastructure that powers vector-based and metadata-based retrieval - enabling high-leverage workflows across data curation, training set construction and ML research.

You’ll work closely with the Technical Lead and peers to scale, and evolve the system that supports retrieval across hundreds of thousands of hours of driving data. You’ll contribute to architectural decisions, own complex components, and help define best practices as the team grows.

You’ll play a key role in launching the next version of our indexing stack, supporting basic similarity search and metadata filtering across hundreds of thousands of hours of video and sensor data. The immediate focus is to move quickly: leverage off-the-shelf tools, help inform build vs. buy decisions, and deliver an MVP system in months - not quarters.

This role requires someone who is comfortable in ambiguity, technically pragmatic, and able to make strong architectural decisions in imperfect conditions. You’ll collaborate with ML teams, platform engineers, and downstream users to turn indexing from a bottleneck into a core capability.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Build and operate production search and indexing systems at billion-vector scale.

- Apply and evaluate embedding models for semantic and multimodal retrieval, including inference, normalization, versioning, and integration.

- Build evaluation frameworks to measure retrieval quality, recall, relevance, filtering accuracy, latency, freshness, scalability, and cost.

- Develop backend services and APIs for vector similarity and metadata-filtered search.

- Own search components from design and implementation through deployment and production operations.

- Collaborate with ML, Data, and Evaluation teams to integrate search into training, curation, and evaluation workflows.

- Support the growth of other engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.

ABOUT YOU

In order to set you up for success at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience:

ESSENTIAL

- 7+ years of experience in backend, infrastructure, or ML systems, building production systems.

- Experience with vector databases or ANN technologies such as FAISS, LanceDB, or similar open-source solutions.

- Strong understanding of multimodal embeddings and experience evaluating search quality across relevance, recall, filtering accuracy, and performance.

- Strong coding skills in Python or other systems languages

- Experience building search services, APIs, and large-scale ingestion and indexing pipelines.

- Experience delivering 0→1 systems in ambiguous or exploratory problem spaces.

- Comfortable working across system boundaries (infra, ML, data curation)

DESIRABLE

- Experience with large-scale ML pipelines or distributed data infrastructure.

- Familiarity with multimodal data, including video, images, sensor data, and metadata.

- Exposure to active learning, semantic retrieval, or training-data selection workflows.

- Prior experience in autonomy, robotics, or large-scale data infrastructure

- Experience evaluating technical vendors and working with external technology providers.

This role is a full-time role based in Sunnyvale, CA (hybrid) and the reasonably estimated salary for this role ranges from $311,850 to $350,625, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

title: Senior Health Data Researcher
description:
About Hello Heart :

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

We’re an AI company focused exclusively on heart health, building a platform that predicts and prevents cardiac events before they happen-identifying risk up to 10 days in advance versus 10 years in traditional clinical models.

This is already working at scale. Hello Heart has been shown to reduce inpatient hospital days by 47% and deliver ~$1,800 in annual savings per member. Hello Heart is the cardiac prevention partner to over 80% of large U.S. health plans and serves hundreds of public and private employers.

We’re defining how the #1 cause of death-heart disease-is managed in the AI era. Join us.

About the Role
Hello Heart is seeking a Senior Health Data Researcher to drive clinical and economic evidence to showcase how Hello Heart products help members understand and improve their heart health through technology and behavioral science.
Reporting into our VP, Commercial Actuary, you will work closely with Medical Affairs, Data Science, Product, Sales, and Marketing to develop research that supports scientific publications, white papers, peer-reviewed publications, conference abstracts, and client-facing evidence. You will apply your expertise in statistics, claims analysis, and clinical research to formulate hypotheses, prepare datasets, conduct statistical analyses, draft manuscripts, incorporate co-author feedback, respond to peer reviews, and present findings to diverse audiences.
This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys rigorous research, clear communication, cross-functional collaboration, and turning complex data into evidence that supports better heart health outcomes.
What you’ll do

• Collaborate with leadership and cross-functional partners to prioritize clinical and economic research topics.

• Generate research questions and develop analytical plans for key publication and evidence-generation priorities.

• Identify, organize, query, and analyze diverse datasets, including clinical, claims, electronic health record (EHR), and engagement data.

• Apply advanced statistical methods, including multilevel modeling, causal inference methods, propensity score matching, mixed-effects modeling, and longitudinal analyses, and sensitivity testing.

• Collaborate with co-authors to incorporate feedback and finalize analyses, manuscripts, white papers, and abstracts.

• Respond to anonymous peer reviews, including repeat analyses and manuscript revisions, to support timely resubmission.

• Identify relevant conferences for abstract submission and present ongoing research when appropriate.

• Stay current on scientific research related to cardiovascular health, digital health, behavioral science, chronic disease, health economics, and public health.

• Contribute to data summaries, research protocols, institutional review board (IRB) materials, and other research documentation.

• Translate complex analytical findings into clear, accurate, and actionable insights for clinical, technical, commercial, and executive audiences.

What you’ll bring

• Strong AI fluency, with the ability to design AI-enabled workflows, such as building or customizing agents others can use while maintaining accuracy, privacy, and human review.

• Graduate degree in a clinical field, epidemiology, biostatistics, public health, or a related field, such as Master of Science (MS), Master of Public Health (MPH), Doctor of Philosophy (PhD), or Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD), with 5+ years of clinical research experience.

• Have previous experience co-authoring relevant clinical publications.

• Strong statistical programming experience with R, Python, SQL, MS Excel, or other relevant analytical tools.

• Strong data skills, including data cleaning, data management, statistical analysis, and data visualization.

• Experience planning and implementing complex statistical analyses while managing deadlines across multiple research priorities.

title: Director of Product Marketing

Pair Team is a public benefit company reimagining care for the safety net. As an AI-enabled medical group for Medicaid and Medicare, we deliver medical, behavioral, and social care by integrating shelters, pantries and other community-based organizations into our whole-person model. As California’s largest complex care provider, we’ve proven our impact to reduce avoidable emergency care, including a 52% and 26% reduction in ER visits and hospitalizations respectively. Once scaled nationally, our approach would save tax payers $150B per year.

With our years of experience and vast data collected, we are now building an AI platform that embeds social work agents across the safety net to truly unify our fragmented healthcare and welfare system. By scaling our country’s frontline medical and social services workforce, we aim to bring high-touch care to everyone.

At Pair Team , we’re not just delivering care-we’re transforming it. We’re building a future where high-touch, community-driven care is accessible to everyone, especially the most underserved.

•
Forbes: For Pair Team , Accessibility Is About Delivering Healthcare To Those Who Need It The Most

•
TechCrunch: Building for Medicaid’s regulatory moment with Neil Batlivala from Pair Team

•
Journal of General Internal Medicine: A Novel Intervention for Medicaid Beneficiaries with Complex Needs

About the Opportunity

As Director of Product Marketing, you will own how Pair Team connects its product to the people we serve. You sit at the intersection of product, growth, and the patient across our service lines and programs within Medicaid and Medicare and you own the work that turns a powerful care platform into patients who enroll, engage, and stay. You are the voice of the patient inside the company and the voice of the product in the market.

You will build a deep, research-backed understanding of who our patients are and what they need, translate it into sharp positioning and messaging, and turn that into the welcome, onboarding, and lifecycle experiences that drive activation and retention. You will protect compliance and patient trust at every step.

This is a fully remote position reporting to the SVP of Growth & Marketing.

Positioning, Messaging & Narrative

description:
About the role

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Developer to help build and harden a TypeScript, front-to-back product built on Next.js 15, React 19, and an AI pipeline powered by Anthropic Claude.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role on a small team. The near-term roadmap is concrete and already scoped: you won't be inventing directions from scratch, you'll be shipping well-defined systems and leveling up the codebase as you go.

Key Responsibilities

• Build the final pipeline agent (the certification builder), including schema design, LLM prompt and output design, and a review and approval workflow

• Own multi-tenant readiness: role-based access control, a membership model, email invitations, and self-serve workspace provisioning

• Bring database maturity to the project: adopt a formal migration workflow and separate staging from production data

• Lead production hardening: rate limiting and usage budgets for AI endpoints, a cloud IAM and security review, secrets and environment hygiene, and error observability

• Set up engineering process: a CI pipeline and broader test coverage

• Improve the structure of a fast-grown codebase while continuing to ship features

• Make build-vs-buy calls, write specs, and mentor a junior engineer

Required Qualifications

• Deep TypeScript and modern React/Next.js experience (App Router, Server Components, Server Actions)

• Production SaaS backend experience: multi-tenant data models, role and permission systems, and auth flows (OAuth, JWT sessions)

• Relational database maturity: Postgres with an ORM (Prisma preferred), a sound migration strategy, and safe schema changes on a live database

• Distributed-systems fundamentals in a serverless world: queues, webhooks, idempotency, retries and backoff, timeouts

• LLM product engineering experience: prompt design, structured and validated outputs, awareness of token costs, and graceful degradation when a model or data source fails

• Security instincts: able to run a cloud IAM review (GCP or equivalent), reason about tenant isolation across data, storage, and real-time layers, and know where rate limiting and secrets hygiene belong

• Strong judgment and comfort being the most senior engineer on the project

• Strong async communication: clear technical questions, documented decisions, and self-surfaced blockers

Nice to Have

• Real-time collaboration experience (Yjs, Liveblocks, or ProseMirror/Tiptap internals)

• Google Cloud specifics: Cloud Run, workload identity federation, GCS signed URLs

• Experience taking an early-stage product to its first paying customers

All our positions are Remote and are available as Full Time Employment or B2B Contracts

description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Synthesia Roleplay Sessions is a training tool that lets people practice real conversations with AI avatars. Instead of just watching training videos, learners do interactive roleplay exercises, like practicing a sales pitch or handling a customer complaint with an AI coach. The AI gives instant feedback so people know what they did well and what to improve.

Managers can use a dashboard to track which employees have completed their training, see how well they performed, and measure if the training actually improved their skills. The whole platform is built around learning by doing rather than just passive video watching.

For your ML engineer role, you'd be building the AI engine that makes the coaching work. That means creating the models that listen to what learners say during roleplay, score their performance, generate helpful feedback in real time, and decide how the AI avatar should respond next based on what the learner does.

This is an applied ML position, not a research one. We expect you to have a good understanding of ML but on the other side to be a good product-focused software developer as you will be expected to work on different products.

- Ability to apply your machine learning knowledge to solve real product problems.

OUR CULTURE

The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. What You Bring

• 5+ years in aviation maintenance operations, with hands-on experience in fleet planning across multiple airframes

• Strong background in military aircraft maintenance and inspection programs, particularly KC-135 operations

• Proficient in predictive, preventive, and prescriptive maintenance strateg

title: Patient & Administrative Support
description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a growing healthcare practice looking for a confident, personable, and highly organized Patient & Administrative Support Assistant to join their remote team.

This role is ideal for someone who is naturally comfortable speaking with people, enjoys solving problems, and can confidently handle phone calls, emails, scheduling, and day-to-day administrative tasks.

You will be an important point of contact for patients and will help ensure that the administrative side of the practice runs smoothly. The successful candidate will be warm and approachable, but also outspoken and confident enough to take ownership of conversations rather than simply taking messages.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their career who is eager to learn, develop their healthcare administration skills, and become a trusted member of a growing team.

Key Responsibilities

Patient & Phone Support

• Answer inbound patient phone calls in a friendly, professional, and confident manner

• Handle general patient questions and direct more complex issues to the appropriate team member

• Take accurate messages and ensure follow-ups are completed

• Communicate with patients via phone, email, and text

• Provide a warm and professional first point of contact for patients

Scheduling & Calendar Management

• Schedule and coordinate patient appointments

• Manage calendars and ensure appointments are accurately recorded

• Assist with rescheduling and appointment changes

• Follow up with patients where required to keep schedules moving

Administrative Support

• Assist with patient billing and invoicing

• Track and follow up on outstanding administrative items

• Support the patient intake process and ensure required information is collected

• Maintain accurate and organized patient and administrative records

• Complete basic Excel and spreadsheet tasks

• Assist with general administrative projects as required

Communication & Follow-Up

• Monitor emails and messages and ensure they receive a timely response

• Track outstanding requests and follow up until they are resolved

• Make sure nothing falls through the cracks

• Escalate issues appropriately when they require clinical or senior-level input

What We're Looking For

The personality fit is extremely important for this role.

We're looking for someone who is:

•
Confident and outspoken - comfortable picking up the phone and speaking with patients

• Warm, personable, and approachable

• An excellent communicator with strong spoken and written English

• Proactive rather than reactive

• Comfortable asking questions and finding solutions

• Highly organized and detail-oriented

• Reliable and able to manage multiple tasks at once

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

About the Role

Lyra is at the forefront of increasing access to evidence-based, efficacious mental health services on a large scale. Lyra has developed innovative blended models of coaching and psychotherapy that combine leading clinical expertise with routine outcomes monitoring and engaging clinical digital tools. Additionally, Lyra offers a robust self-care library, which includes evidence-based articles, mindfulness resources, and other wellbeing tools. Scientific publications on Lyra’s mental health coaching, psychotherapy, medication management, and workforce mental health programs provide strong evidence for the clinical effectiveness of these evidence-based treatment programs.

We are seeking a highly skilled licensed psychologist with exceptional clinical expertise, writing skills, and content development experience who is passionate about developing client-facing materials (articles, quick tips, short psychoeducational videos, etc.) that teach evidence-based mental health skills. You will be part of a highly skilled, creative, and collaborative team with an established track record for developing effective and engaging digital clinical materials on emotional wellness and psychotherapy skills. By directly reaching tens of thousands of clients, your work on self-care materials and AI tools will help create meaningful positive change on a large scale.

Responsibilities

• Develop high-impact self-care resources: Review the evidence-base, write, and integrate significant feedback to create engaging resources, including articles, storytelling, short videos, quick tips, and exercises.

• Create customized content for key populations: Develop tailored resources for special populations, conducting qualitative research (e.g., surveying providers) to enhance clinical value for our diverse member base.

• Contribute to member outreach: Collaborate with Marketing teams on monthly campaigns, provide clinical review, and represent the clinical perspective in strategy discussions.

• Support AI tool development: Contribute to clinical AI tool development and refinement, including testing, quality assurance monitoring, and writing gold-standard responses and dialogues to ensure safety and clinical effectiveness.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Partner with Product, Design, and other teams at Lyra on self-care initiatives.

• Contribute to self-care innovation: Track emerging trends and research in the self-care landscape to inform and propose ideas to increase engagement and clinical value, including reviewing sources of content to consider licensing.

• Provide internal training: Develop and deliver trainings for internal teams to support dissemination of self-care resources across Ly

description:
At IONOS, the leading European provider of cloud infrastructure, cloud services and hosting services, you will work together with a wide range of teams. We are characterized by open structures, a friendly working culture and flat hierarchies with a strong team spirit. We firmly believe that work and fun are compatible, and offer you the right environment for this. Our constant growth means that we are always looking for new colleagues. Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

 

At IONOS, we are not merely developing web solutions; we are actively powering the digital backbone of Europe. To ensure our operations run at peak efficiency, we are seeking a Senior Cloud Procurement Expert who possesses a deep understanding of both high-level finance and intricate technology. This role transcends traditional procurement; it involves architecting the commercial relationships that are essential for sustaining our cloud infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor, leading complex sourcing initiatives without the responsibilities of people management. You will act as the vital link between technical visionaries and commercial realities.

• Strategic Sourcing: Oversee end-to-end procurement cycles for IT, Cloud, and Software, ensuring partnerships with the industry's best.

• Commercial Mastery: Negotiate high-stakes contracts to secure favorable commercial terms and robust legal protections.

• Stakeholder Synergy: Serve as the primary point of contact for vendors and internal technical teams, minimizing friction and alleviating procurement complexities for our engineers.

• Process Excellence: Advocate for procurement standards to guarantee that every deal is compliant, transparent, and high-performing.

Qualifications

• Cloud Fluency: Significant experience in IT/Software procurement (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), with a thorough understanding of cloud licensing.

• Negotiation Expertise: A demonstrated history of managing complex RFPs and multi-million-euro negotiations.

• Analytical Mindset: You assess success through metrics such as savings, cycle times, and contract compliance.

• Hybrid working model.

• Modern office environment with excellent transport links.

• Access to various employee discounts on activities and products.

With its Web Presence & Productivity portfolio, IONOS acts as a 'one-stop shop' for all digitalization needs: from domains and web hosting to classic website builders and do-it-yourself solutions, from e-commerce to online marketing tools. title: Lead Backend Engineer
description:
ABOUT ZEGO 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance. We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖. For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Zego-Insurance-EI_IE1851459.11,25.htm.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

What you will be doing

- Lead several engineers within a team or workstream, guiding their work towards user value and business opportunity

- Design, build and own the Python microservices that power our insurance platform: secure, observable and built for scale

- Drive architectural discussions and decisions across multiple teams, shaping the future of our backend systems

- Deliver large, complex technical initiatives end to end, with clarity on scope, sequencing and impact

- Raise the bar on engineering excellence: testability, reliability, scalability and clean code

- Coach and mentor engineers, sharing context, feedback and support so the whole team levels up

- Improve how the team works, from CI/CD pipelines to incident response, investigating root causes and fixing them pragmatically

 

What you will need to be successful

- Deep backend expertise - Hands-on experience building cloud-native microservices, Python preferred, though strong experience in another language works too!

- Systems at scale - You have built distributed architectures and understand performance tuning and observability, on top of solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms and system design

- You strive for simplicity - You build systems that are easy to understand, test and maintain, and you weigh trade-offs rather than reaching for complexity

- You lead by example - Through mentoring, clear communication and a collaborative mindset, plus the tenacity to find a way forward through ambiguity or tough technical problems

- You are proactive with people beyond engineering - You raise concerns early, engage the right people, and explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders

- You work AI-first - You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable

THE ZEGO WAYS OF WORKING 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our central London office weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QKOYDx6AMxQ.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution

Decisions move through CIOs, research computing directors, principal investigators, sponsored programs offices, procurement, and consortium contract vehicles, often in parallel and not always in agreement.

That environment rewards someone who can hold a lot of context at once, translate between very different audiences, and connect technology to the outcomes these institutions actually care about: time to result for researchers, compliance with sponsor and grant requirements, data that stays usable for a decade or more, and budgets that have to stretch further every year.

You will be the technical lead on these accounts, working alongside account managers, specialists, and partners to build solutions customers can defend internally, both technically and financially.
